# 4-port fabrication layers

[Project overview](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Two-layer Gerber and Excellon data generated from the native KiCad board.

Use the [parent fabrication ZIP](../thor-4port-A1-fabrication-REVIEW.zip) to keep the layer set together. These files are for **A1 engineering review**, not an approved 50-unit order.

| Layer family | Purpose |
|---|---|
| F_Cu / B_Cu | Top routing and bottom copper/reference plane |
| F_Mask / B_Mask | Solder-mask openings |
| F_Paste / F_Silkscreen | Top stencil and component markings |
| Edge_Cuts | Finished board outline |
| PTH / NPTH | Separate plated and non-plated drill files and maps |
| Gerber job | Exported layer/job metadata |

Nominal stack: 1.6 mm FR4, two layers, 1 oz copper. Supplier stackup, mask, panelization and assembly checks remain required. [Manufacturing guide](../../../docs/manufacturing.md).
